issues.message: CHK-001 is missing userSees (the specific text the user sees in the terminal/UI after completing this item). Example: 'User sees "✓ File created: hello.txt" then returns to the prompt'

acceptance_binding_missing_verification_intent_refs: AB-fb7b-001 has no verificationIntentRefs. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

understanding still has 3 undigested unknowns: RESOLVED (decision_set): RED shape = a fast structural invariant smoke wired into validate.commands (bootstrap-runner requires utils/dist + test invokes full-suite-runner + pretest actually builds both packages, main before utils) PLUS a behavioral repro-first RED that runs npm run pretest and asserts packages/utils/dist is produced; both are non-destructive (no dist removal).; RESOLVED (decision_set): the always-on pretest main build is additive and reproduces identical dist bytes, so it does not conflict with the packages-main-build proof receipt or materialHash freshness.; RESOLVED (decision_set): register the fast structural smoke in validate.commands as the permanent guard; keep the heavier behavioral RED as tests/red evidence only (not in validate.commands, to avoid a build on every validate).

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-fb7b --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
